scope: Real Chrome (Claude in Chrome) on http://127.0.0.1:5174 against the Vite dev server of branch codex/r-b (measurement history panel and automatic persistence). Localhost only; not the published site.

checks.name: panel-present
checks.detail: #measurement-history with name, save, export, import, clear, note, status, list and 'other results' elements was present; no console errors.

checks.name: save-after-gui-probe
checks.detail: Without a prior GUI probe the save was refused ('Probe a point on the result first'; analysisApi.probe does not set the panel's probe by design). After a click on the bar in probe mode (position [10.000, 6.107, 28.040] mm, displacement 0.028040 mm) the save created a list row 'mid' with point, field, value and unit and a remove button; window.measurementApi.list returned count 1.

checks.name: browser-persistence-written
checks.detail: IndexedDB database airpocket-measurement-history (store kv) held two keys: 'index' and 'archive:<result sha>'; localStorage fallback was not used.

checks.name: other-result-entries-not-listed
checks.detail: After reload and recomputation the result revision differs, so the earlier entry was not listed for the new result (stored data stays under its own key).

checks.name: restore-when-same-result-displayed
checks.detail: Saved a measurement 'persist-me' and a case, exported the case archive, reloaded the page, imported the case archive (the archive does not contain the measurement history) and viewed the case: the list showed 'persist-me' for the same point and value again and measurementApi.list returned count 1, i.e. the entry came back from browser storage.

findings: Because a recomputed result gets a new result revision even for identical inputs, entries are visible again only when the same stored result is displayed (for example by importing a case archive); a plain re-run does not bring them back.

The 'entries for other results' count line is computed from the in-memory archive, so after a reload it stays empty until the matching result is displayed (it did not show the count for the old revision).
The panel language follows the app language; in this session the page was in Japanese even with ?lang=en in the URL, so the panel labels were Japanese.
notVerified: localStorage fallback and storage-failure tolerance in a real browser (unit tests only).
Export/import JSON buttons in the real page (unit tests with the real validators only).
Other browsers and operating systems; the 100-entry / 300,000-byte caps in the real page.
